items.exampleEn: The manufacture of glass needs very high temperatures.
items.exampleZh: 製造玻璃需要非常高的溫度。

items.exampleEn: I found a rusty old key in the garden.
items.exampleZh: 我在花園裡找到一把生鏽的舊鑰匙。

items.exampleEn: Each bowl is made by a skilled craftsman.
items.exampleZh: 每一個碗都是由技術熟練的工匠製作的。

items.exampleEn: A workman painted the white lines on the new road.
items.exampleZh: 一位工人在新馬路上畫白線。

items.exampleEn: The company plans to mechanize its packing line next year.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司計畫明年把包裝線機械化。

items.exampleEn: The church is famous for its beautiful stonework.
items.exampleZh: 那座教堂以美麗的石造工藝聞名。

items.sentenceEn: This company manufactures bicycles in a small factory in Taichung.
items.sentenceZh: 這家公司在台中的一間小工廠製造腳踏車。

items.audioEn: My French is a bit rusty, because I haven't spoken it for ten years.
items.audioZh: 我的法文有點生疏了，因為我已經十年沒說了。
items.questionZh: 說話者的法文為什麼變生疏？
options: Spoke it only for ten days

items.sentenceEn: Two workmen are repairing the roof of our building today.
items.sentenceZh: 今天有兩個工人在修我們大樓的屋頂。

items.sentenceEn: The farm was mechanized, so it needed only a few workers.
items.sentenceZh: 那座農場機械化了，所以只需要少數幾個工人。

items.stemEn: The ____ spent three months carving the wooden door by hand.
items.stemZh: 那位工匠花了三個月手工雕刻那扇木門。

items.stemEn: The old bicycle was so ____ that the chain would not move.
items.stemZh: 那輛舊腳踏車鏽得很嚴重，鏈條都轉不動了。

items.passageEn: Last year, my parents bought an old stone house in the countryside. It is not a mansion, but it has a lovely terrace and thick walls. The stonework was in good shape, but the iron gate was rusty and the windows were broken. My father hired a local craftsman who still makes windows by hand, the old way. He told us that most windows today are manufactured in factories, because the work has been mechanized. Two workmen helped him for a month. My father also wanted to help, but his skills were rusty, so he mostly made coffee for everyone.
items.passageZh: 去年，我爸媽在鄉下買了一間老石屋。它不是豪宅，但有一個很棒的露台和厚厚的牆。石造的部分狀況良好，但鐵門生鏽了，窗戶也破了。我爸爸請了一位當地的工匠，他到現在還用傳統的方式手工做窗戶。他告訴我們，現在大部分的窗戶都是在工廠製造的，因為這項工作已經機械化了。有兩名工人幫了他一個月。我爸爸也想幫忙，但他的手藝生疏了，所以他主要是幫大家泡咖啡。

questions.questionZh: 那間石屋買來時是什麼狀況？
options: 整間房子都需要重新蓋過
屋頂和地板都已經不見了

items.promptZh: 村裡那位工匠常常受邀到國外教課。
referenceEn: The craftsman in the village is often invited to teach abroad.
The village craftsman is often asked to teach in other countries.
rubricZh: 「受邀」可寫，例如 is invited to、is asked to 等

items.promptZh: 這些手機是在越南製造的。
referenceEn: These phones were manufactured in Vietnam.
These phones are manufactured in Vietnam.
rubricZh: manufacture 用被動式（例如 were manufactured、are manufactured 等）
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 were、are 等）
